en-US: Build 187: GitHub Actions jobs are saved by the App. Reopening or returning to the foreground refreshes unfinished builds automatically, without keeping a model conversation running. Notes shows a labelled content summary for supported Word, Excel and PowerPoint files while the system preview loads, then upgrades it when available. Summaries do not reproduce the original layout; Excel summaries use the first sheet. Office back navigation accessibility has been corrected. Please test closing and reopening during a cloud build, cancellation confirmation, logs and artifact downloads, plus document covers, renaming and returning to the library. Native Office/Pencil operation and the reported iPad local-model chat crash still need physical-device verification. Bring your own cloud-model credentials. Include device, OS, model and the shortest reproduction in feedback.
zh-Hans: Build 187：GitHub Actions 任务由 App 持久保存，重开 App 或返回前台会主动刷新未完成构建，不需要让模型一直等待。手记对支持的 Word、Excel、PPT 先显示带标识的内容摘要，系统预览就绪后再升级；摘要不等于原始排版，Excel 摘要取第一张工作表。修复 Office 返回导航的辅助功能标识。请重点测试构建期间关闭和重开 App、取消确认、日志与产物下载，以及文档封面、重命名、返回资料列表。原生 Office/Pencil 操作和已报告的 iPad 本地模型聊天闪退仍需真机核验。云端模型使用自己的凭据。反馈请带设备、系统、模型和最短复现。
